+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Build or run independent Athena hydro with one CPU thread and finite caps."""

+HERE=Path(__file__).resolve().parent

+
+
+def limits():
+    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(900*2**20,900*2**20))
+    resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(1800,1805))

+
+start=time.monotonic()
